{"text":"ItemID: NA; Title: The Endless River; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Atmospheric instrumental rock is less appealing right now than the bluesy songs in my recent listening.
ItemID: NA; Title: Sgt. Pepper's Lonely Hearts Club Band Super Deluxe; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am more interested in another album to explore than an expanded edition of a familiar classic.
ItemID: NA; Title: Hypnotic Eye; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: You Should Be So Lucky makes me interested in hearing more from Benmont Tench with Tom Petty and the Heartbreakers; I would pick this.
ItemID: NA; Title: Nothing Has Changed; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: A broad Bowie retrospective is not what I am looking for after these recent blues and roots records.
ItemID: NA; Title: Don Henley Cass County; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its country direction could suit my interest in Blown Away, but it is not my first choice today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Crosseyed Heart; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The rootsy rock and blues sound appeals to me, but I would leave it for another visit.
ItemID: NA; Title: U.S. Albums; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: A large Beatles collection feels like more of a commitment than I want right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Down Where the Spirit Meets the Bone; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The roots-oriented songwriting sounds promising, though I would choose a closer connection to my recent listening first.
ItemID: NA; Title: In My Soul; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Soulful blues fits the mood of Memphis and Old Sock, but I am only choosing a couple of records.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Breeze: An Appreciation of JJ Cale; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Having recently listened to Old Sock, I would choose this for more of Clapton's relaxed blues and roots sound."}
